Version 1.7.0 (approximately) is expected to be available in the near future.
The following is the plan for the future version, as well as the progress Note: The following content is unconfirmed, please refer to the actual announcement!

1.8 (this version will most likely be overwritten) [full of unconfirmed content] A new map in some sense? , more custom business cards?

notes.title: 1.22.2 Update!
notes.content:
Our games have always been based on realism
At the same time, it is necessary to make adjustments about the player experience.
In this update, we installed a realistic physiological system to make the game more realistic.
The following is the update.

Fatigue system renewal
Players will be tired from running too much.
After the fatigue effect is triggered, the player's recovery speed will slow down and his heart rate and blood oxygen will also be affected.

Blood oxygen mechanism addition
If the blood oxygen is too low in the game, it will lead to a decrease in the recovery health.
There are many mechanisms that affect blood oxygen, including but not limited to running and eating high-energy foods.

Dynamic display of secondary physiological values
Now the value of the secondary biological sign of the player's medical panel will be displayed normally.
Players can use these values to judge whether your character is normal or not.

Cause of death shows
After the player dies in the game, you don't need to find someone else to do an autopsy for you!
After the player dies, your cause of death will be displayed in the death panel.
Of course, he will only show the specific cause of death and will not tell you what caused the death.

The above is the specific content of this update.
Our update direction during this period is mainly based on simulation.
All kinds of behaviors of players in the game may influence the characters manipulated in the game.
To give players a more immersive and realistic experience.

notes.title: 0.53 beat patch
notes.content:
This update solves an important problem and makes some adjustments.

Many players reported that they could not enter the game. After our investigation, we locked the problem and solved it!
Now all players can enter the game normally.

There are also some bugs, such as not playing UI animation when treating massive hemorrhage, and being unable to use mobile phones, which have been fixed.

Adjusted the player's power consumption and food consumption.

We are sorry to have caused such a big problem to the players and prevented them from playing the game normally.
We are deeply sorry for this.

notes.title: Beta beta update!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone, we have released a beta version. Here are the details of the update.

Medical system renewal
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/24f6f4d287317c858426f430651e8daa5a27e62b.png
Players need to go to this page to use medical items such as tourniquets and splints.
Painkillers and medical kits can still be used in the backpack page.
This medical system can facilitate complex treatment in the future.

Mobile phone system update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/f30d0750d5f45734aff692084b2ce6adc6b60c3f.png
There are two applications in it, namely information and map. Players can use these applications by pressing ~ and calling out the mouse.

Chat interface change
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/79e29a36f76d48e07381c9e4989ce9d0aac7098e.png
We moved the chat interface to the mobile phone software, and players need it in their mobile phones to use it.

Navigation system update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/e1024b3f9b91045312647c8326ef1b5dad1e4de5.png
The new navigation system can help players get familiar with the game terrain faster, but unfortunately, not all maps can be used.

Brand new map Deke nature reserve
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/37924e2494c603a3500830c88b12b9aea391a694.png
This is the second map of our game, which contains many new mechanisms (such as bonfires that can be lit). Unfortunately, many contents (including unopened areas and map stories) have not been added in this update because of problems.
There will be brand-new monsters in this map.

New backpack interface and equipment system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/bfdfc1dafcb031ad323d3835f70f41c4173814eb.png
The knapsack system has been improved, and you can now equip yourself freely with items.

Brand-new items

notes.title: We have noticed serious bugs in the game.
notes.content:
1.The player's name will disappear after the player sets something in the settings of the main menu.
What you can do now is to avoid setting something.

2.The second time the player enters the game after setting the language, it will become the default language (English).
What you can do now is not to set the language for the time being.

We will fix these two bugs urgently.
You can still play until it is repaired.

notes.title: Guys, we have opened up new test content. 0.1.12Alpha
notes.content:
Guys, we have opened up new test content.
The following are the contents of this update.

New Content
1. Add a bleeding system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/2d71e86a60912f17327fc81b8d9f6ef008ce23f7.png
Players are likely to bleed after being attacked by some AI.
After bleeding, the player's health will be continuously reduced.
After a period of time, the bleeding effect will disappear automatically (provided that you have a lot of health points)

2.New drugs, blood band, gauze.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/6ecdda2185fbfb87de492ee1a389c5617c8bc508.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/b655f2eeac87c332dedb804a786cd933db903ea3.png
Drugs such as tourniquet can help you treat bleeding, while gauze may treat bleeding.

3. Add an analgesic system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/a5da5d921b361d8da10469355231ffcac01b886b.png
After being attacked by AI, the screen will not be blurred (except mental attack)

4.Add painkillers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/5ad0c76c81ce205a80fb9279565d83368b0932df.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/9c6f61aebf7ef1df2bc2d4a470b8b925ee3bca85.png
After use, the analgesic effect can be obtained.

5.Naming system update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/5be74d9e52d2b397d1a040e76e944a1ab0d03bd6.png
You just need to set it up when you first enter the game, and you won't need to repeat the input as before.

6.Brief introduction system of backpack
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/9f78a9f3616ee226fc9021c66bf608cf082dfff0.png
You can put the mouse on the color bar so that you can see the introduction of this item under the backpack.
And can judge the color of the color block, the color depth to judge its function and dosage.

BUG Repair
1.Unable to clear customs after the victory conditions are met.
2.You can't use items after the backpack interface is attacked

Adjust
1.The physical strength of the player has been increased.
2.Some adjustments have been made to AI.
3.The map layout has been slightly adjusted.


Finally, don't forget that it's normal to have problems with the beta version.
We hope that players can actively participate and help us find these problems.
